title: Export Pipeline
description:
Multi-format export for sharing and printing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- SVG export (vector, print-ready)
- PNG export (rasterized, web-friendly)
- PDF export (for direct printing)

title: Implement SVG export
description:
Native SVG export:
- Serialize SVG element to string
- Add XML declaration and proper namespace
- Trigger download with .svg extension
- Ensure fonts are embedded or converted to paths

title: Implement PNG export
description:
Rasterized export:
- Render SVG to canvas
- Export canvas as PNG
- Support resolution scaling (1x, 2x, 4x for print)
- Handle large dimensions for poster sizes

title: Implement PDF export
description:
PDF for direct printing:
- Use jsPDF or similar library
- Embed SVG as vector (not rasterized)
- Support common poster sizes (A3, A2, 18x24)
- Proper margins for print

title: Data Schema & Prompt
description:
Define the JSON schema for influence graphs and write a Claude prompt that reliably produces well-structured influence data.

## Acceptance Criteria
- JSON schema defined and documented
- Claude prompt tested and producing valid output
- Handles edge cases (unknown people, ambiguous names)

title: Define JSON schema for influence graph
description:
Define the data structure for nodes and edges.

```json
{
  "subject": "string",
  "nodes": [{ "id": "string", "name": "string", "depth": number }],
  "links": [{ "source": "string", "target": "string" }]
}
```

Consider: node sizing data, optional metadata fields for v2.

title: Write Claude prompt for influence generation
description:
Prompt that takes a name and outputs valid JSON with 3 levels of influences.

Requirements:
- Output must be valid JSON (no markdown wrapping)
- 3-5 influences per person
- Handles disambiguation (which John Williams?)
- Graceful fallback for obscure figures

title: Test prompt reliability
description:
Test the prompt with diverse inputs:
- Musicians (Eno, Coltrane, Björk)
- Authors (Borges, Toni Morrison, Kafka)
- Philosophers (Wittgenstein, Simone de Beauvoir)
- Edge cases (very obscure, ambiguous names)

Document failure modes and refine prompt.

title: Polish & Edge Cases
description:
Error handling, loading states, and UX refinements.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Loading spinner during API calls
- Graceful handling of unknown/ambiguous names
- Circular influence detection
- Responsive layout considerations

title: Add loading states
description:
Visual feedback during operations:
- Spinner during API call
- Progress indication for graph layout settling
- Disable inputs while loading

title: Handle unknown/ambiguous names
description:
Graceful failure modes:
- "Person not found" message
- Disambiguation UI (which John Williams?)
- Suggestions for similar names

title: Detect and handle circular influences
description:
Mutual influence handling:
- Detect A→B and B→A in data
- Decide: show both, merge, or indicate bidirectional?
- Prevent infinite loops in traversal

title: Basic responsive layout
description:
Ensure usability on different screens:
- Minimum viable mobile experience
- Canvas resizing on window resize
- Touch-friendly export buttons

title: API Integration
description:
Wire up Claude API calls from Observable with user-provided API key.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Text input for API key (stored in localStorage)
- Name input triggers Claude API call
- Response parsed and fed to visualization
- Basic error handling for API failures

title: Add API key input with localStorage persistence
description:
UI for API key:
- Text input field (password type)
- Save to localStorage on change
- Load from localStorage on page load
- Clear button

title: Implement Claude API call from browser
description:
Direct API call to Claude:
- Use fetch() with proper headers
- Handle CORS (may need to use messages endpoint)
- Parse JSON response
- Extract influence data from response

title: Wire API response to visualization
description:
Connect the pieces:
- Name input triggers API call
- Parse response into graph data structure
- Feed to d3-force simulation
- Re-render on new data

title: Add basic API error handling
description:
Handle common failures:
- Invalid API key
- Rate limiting
- Network errors
- Malformed response

title: Core Visualization
description:
Observable notebook with d3-force rendering the influence graph with dark aesthetic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Observable notebook scaffold working
- d3-force layout with subject pinned at center
- Dark theme (charcoal bg, cream nodes)
- Renders correctly with mock data

title: Scaffold Observable notebook
description:
Create the basic Observable notebook structure:
- Import d3, d3-force
- Set up SVG canvas
- Basic cell organization

title: Implement d3-force layout with radial pinning
description:
Force simulation setup:
- Subject node pinned at center
- Depth-based radial forces (influences pull toward rings)
- Collision detection to prevent overlap
- Link forces for connected nodes

title: Apply dark theme and typography
description:
Visual styling:
- Dark charcoal background (#1a1a1a)
- Cream/off-white nodes
- Clean sans-serif labels (Inter or similar)
- Node size scales with influence reach
- Central node gets accent treatment

title: Create mock data for development
description:
Hand-craft 2-3 example influence graphs for testing:
- Brian Eno (music)
- Jorge Luis Borges (literature)
- One more diverse example

Use these to develop viz without API dependency.
